authority: MAP DESIGNS THE PHYSICAL WORLD. GAMEPLAY POPULATES AND SIMULATES IT.
creatorRule: Full 2000x1400 authoring frame UNCHANGED. No rescale/crop/warp of canon. Transform metadata explicit; no premature runtime tile binding.

source.gameplayAck: PR44 issue comment 6608030530 @ 0b2ba508 (two-stage geography/population; temporary engine constants)

defectCorrection.priorRule: poiFeetUnableToHostSmallestRoom used F.poiFoot.minEdgeAu (GLOBAL 11 au) for all 81 POIs plus a flat area threshold; reported 81/81 failures at U=4 and U=8.
defectCorrection.correction: Each POI now measured with its own quad OBB, own edge lengths and own deep polygon; enclosure class separates open-air yards from enclosed rooms; only enclosed POIs are tested for a room.
defectCorrection.note: The corrected count is NOT directly comparable to 81/81 because the population and the rule both changed. It is a per-POI measurement, not a global multiplication.

boundedBandStatement: Physical-fit evidence supports a BOUNDED BAND U in [1, 2.5] among the tested candidates, not a single approved integer. U=2 is one member, NOT canonized. Fractional U within the band has explicit raster-coverage costs measured below.

coverage.note: For fractional U the last runtime row/column is partial. Any runtime intake must choose one documented mode; none is approved.

raster.sourceCellsWithTileBoundaryInsideMeaning: Upsampling count: a tile boundary inside an 8 au source cell. When 8/U is an INTEGER the clip is exact and costs no resampling.
raster.runtimeTileStraddleMeaning: A source-cell EDGE falling strictly inside a runtime tile. This is the explicit fractional-coverage cost and is ZERO when 8/U is an integer.
raster.note: Fractional U needs a documented FLOOR/CEIL/NONUNIFORM mode for partial edge tiles AND a resampling rule for 8 au source cells cut mid-tile.

perPoi.entranceCapacityStatus: NOT an authored opening: canonical POIs have zero door dimensions; this is each POI's own shortest-edge UPPER BOUND.
perPoi.proposedEntranceStatus: 3.696 au GEO-02 PROPOSED po_kilns opening; NON-CANONICAL worked example only.

scale01aDefectReproduction.flawedRule: footAreaAu2/U^2 < 20 || GLOBAL_minEdgeAu/U < 4, applied to all 81 POIs
scale01aDefectReproduction.note: SCALE-01A reported 81/81 at U=4 and U=8 because it used the global 11 au minimum edge for every POI. The corrected count only considers ENCLOSED POIs and each POI's own quad.

raster.note: Fractional U needs a documented FLOOR/CEIL/NONUNIFORM mode for partial edge tiles AND a resampling rule for 8 au source cells cut mid-tile.
